description:
### Fixes
- **Fix share links**: reddit.com/media image links open in rif's image viewer instead of the wrong post.
- **Inline images**: those links now show as images in comments.

### Adding this bundle
In ReVanced Manager, add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MojiRS/revanced-rif-patches/main/bundles/stable.json` as a remote patch source. Requires rif is fun **5.6.22** (free or Golden Platinum), patched together with the official ReVanced bundle's **Spoof client** patch.
